name: Whimbrel
tagline: In Local-only mode, your client calls stay on your computer
description: Whimbrel is a private AI memory for Mac and Windows that records meetings without a bot, keeps a page for every client, and stores recordings on your computer, not on our servers.

requirements.mac: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer)

demoVideo.title: Whimbrel product tour
demoVideo.description: A one-minute walkthrough of Whimbrel with Wi-Fi off: a meeting recorded without a bot and transcribed on the computer, its summary, a page for the client, and a cited answer from a local model.

whatsNewVideo.title: What's new in Whimbrel 0.9.80
whatsNewVideo.description: A one-minute walkthrough of what's new in Whimbrel 0.9.80: the four controls on a client's page (delete, keep, export, exclude from hosted models) and encrypting the memory database. Shown in the Windows app with fictional demo data; the controls and the encryption are on Mac and Windows.
